rationale: Builds on the 1.5111 staged reverse-tail baseline by spending a small amount of remaining int8+zlib budget on the penultimate recurrent-tail value matrix. The current export path already protects tail Q/K, both tail projections, and the final block V; extending the same FP16 rescue to the adjacent repeated V tensor should reduce quantization error where the reverse recurrent pass reuses value-path information, without changing the training loop, data order, recurrence topology, or final exact evaluation.
title: Penultimate Tail Value FP16 Rescue
